text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear… I'm at a loss for words…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wanted to prove to everyone how wonderful you are, but…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I will win next time. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I didn't get the results I wanted this time, but you still believe in me… right?
choice_data_list: I want you to believe in me, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Right! I'll prove that it was right of you to put your faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I hope you look forward to my next race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll put my all into aiming for first place so I can spoil you silly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I do believe in you, Trainer. In fact, I've never once doubted you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But thank you for the reminder. I'll make sure your hopes for me aren't for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As long as I have you to guide me, I won't lose my way.
